title: COMP-MODEL-AB-DECISION stage-run contract: runner discriminator, spec extension, per-run record, budget, runKey
_source: docs/features/COMP-MODEL-AB-DECISION/plan.md ### G1 (COMP-STAGE-GRADING-1); legacy shapes from docs/features/COMP-MODEL-AB/plan.md ## Contract and lib/dispatch-ledger.js:62-67
_changelog: 2026-10-20 G1 (COMP-STAGE-GRADING-1): first version. Legacy spec and run record transcribed unchanged; stage and build runner shapes, budget, runKey and the four named refusals added. Extended later by D1 (ingredients, precedence) and R2 (metrics.steps[]).

2026-10-20 G1 fix round 1 (COMP-STAGE-GRADING-1): stageDispatchRow keeps the shipped nullable ledger semantics and the full field vocabulary; effort is the catalog enum and worked identities follow the resolver; digest content sources and the checkpoint decision table are machine-readable; worked digests are bound to stated content.

2026-10-20 G2 (COMP-STAGE-GRADING-2): stage runs carry unknown token usage as null, never 0. New $defs.stageCostMetrics (costMetrics with tokensIn/tokensOut nullable) used by stageRunMetrics.cost; legacy costMetrics unchanged. Example: stage run record with a null-usage receipt.
description: Validate an instance by pointing at one of $defs (see examples[].validatesAgainst and negativeExamples[].mustFailAgainst). The root carries no instance shape of its own.

runnerDiscriminator.meaning: whole build, then the archetype oracle after collect

ARCHETYPE_UNKNOWN.enforcedBy: validateSpec (needs the archetype registry; not expressible as schema)
ARCHETYPE_UNKNOWN.when: fixture.archetype names an id the loader does not know

CONFIG_SHAPE_MISMATCH.enforcedBy: schema: specStage / specBuild config shapes are closed (additionalProperties false) and each requires its own keys
CONFIG_SHAPE_MISMATCH.when: a stage config carries implementer or reviewer, a build config carries candidate, or a stage spec has a config with no candidate

ARCHETYPE_RUNNER_UNSUPPORTED.when: archetype.runner === "build"; the schema specBuild exists so the shape is fixed now

JUDGED_STAGE_CLAUDE_ONLY.enforcedBy: schema specStageJudged (candidate pattern is claude only); validateSpec selects it when archetype.judged is true
JUDGED_STAGE_CLAUDE_ONLY.when: a non-Claude candidate on a judged: true archetype

BUDGET_REQUIRED.enforcedBy: schema: budget is required in specStage, specStageJudged and specBuild, optional in specLegacy
BUDGET_REQUIRED.when: an archetype spec has no budget

BUDGET_STOP.when: a run was never started because the budget stopped the experiment

rules.cost: metrics.cost of a stage run is the sum over the sandbox's dispatch-ledger rows with site "experiment-stage" (see $defs.stageDispatchRow); usd (and tokensIn, tokensOut) is null if any such row has it null, or if there is no such row (#/$defs/stageCostMetrics). Read from the ledger, never from the agentRun return value.
rules.runKey: sha256 (hex) of the canonical JSON (keys sorted at every depth, no whitespace) of runKeyInputs. Digest content sources are in rules.digests; absent pipeline/profiles files give null digests, never an empty-string hash.
rules.canonicalJson: JSON.stringify with object keys sorted lexicographically at every depth; arrays keep order.

pipelineDigest.source: the raw bytes of the workflow's pipeline file as copied into the sandbox (D1), read as-is: no newline, whitespace or YAML normalisation
pipelineDigest.absent: null when the workflow has no pipeline file

profilesDigest.source: the parsed JSON content of the workflow's profiles sidecar, so formatting and key order do not matter
profilesDigest.hash: sha256 hex of canonicalJson(parsed sidecar); same canonicalisation as lib/pipeline-profiles.js:180-184 profilesDigest
profilesDigest.absent: null when the workflow has no sidecar (bug-fix has none)

fixtureDigest.source: the parsed JSON content of the archetype's fixture file, including gold and hidden fields, so any fixture edit changes it
fixtureDigest.hash: sha256 hex of canonicalJson(parsed fixture file)
fixtureDigest.absent: never null: an archetype run always has a fixture

catalogDigest.source: the catalogDigest member of the model catalog payload (lib/model-catalog.js:14), as produced by stratum models --json
catalogDigest.hash: taken verbatim, never recomputed by compose

digests.boundExamples: $.rules.digestSources lists stated contents and their digests; the worked runKeyInputs below use exactly those values, and the oracle recomputes both.

checkpoint.description: How B1 decides what to do with the existing record of a run slot before provision. Evaluate the rows top to bottom, first match wins. Input: existing (the record on disk for this runId, or null), newRunKey (computed from runKeyInputs now), rerun (null, "failed", "all", or a literal runId from --rerun). Output: dispatch (start the run) and archivePrev (move the old record to <runId>.json.prev-<epoch> first). A record is TERMINAL iff it is executed (not runSkipped), has no _error, and budget.stoppedBy is null or "timeout" (a model timeout IS terminal; a budget stop on maxRuns, maxUsdTotal or maxTokensTotal is not). A skipped record has no runKey, so it is never compared.

rows.when: existing is executed and existing.runKey !== newRunKey (any rerun value)
rerun === "failed" and the record is not terminal, or is terminal with budget.stoppedBy "timeout"
existing.budget.stoppedBy is maxRuns, maxUsdTotal or maxTokensTotal

agentString.description: agentStr per lib/agent-string.js: provider[:template[:tier]]; provider from PROVIDERS, tier segment may be empty (claude::standard).

specLegacy.description: Case (a). Today's shape, unchanged. fixture.archetype is absent by construction (closed fixture).

specStage.description: Case (b), non-judged archetype. budget required (BUDGET_REQUIRED). One agentRun per run, so perRunTimeoutMs replaces buildTimeoutMs.

specStageJudged.description: Case (b) when archetype.judged is true (design, plan): same as specStage with Claude-only candidates.

specBuild.description: Case (c). Whole build then the archetype oracle. validateSpec refuses it with ARCHETYPE_RUNNER_UNSUPPORTED until R1; the shape is fixed here.

stageCostMetrics.description: metrics.cost of a stage run (rules.cost). A summed field is null when any summed ledger row has it null, or when the run left no experiment-stage row: unknown usage is never 0.

stageMetrics.description: metrics.stage. An oracle that cannot run sets oracleError and accuracy null, never accuracy 0.

candidateResolved.description: From resolveAgentConfig (lib/agent-string.js) plus the catalog digest; never a tier name.

stageArtifacts.description: Rubric and review oracles read outputPath.

runKeyInputs.description: The object hashed into runKey. candidate (stage) XOR implementer+reviewer (build). ingredients is added by D1; B1 owns the terminal / retry / mismatch rules.

stageRunExecuted.description: An archetype run (runner stage or build) that started. candidateResolved is required for runner stage and absent for runner build.

runSkipped.description: A run never started because the budget stopped the experiment; retried by the checkpoint rule.

stageDispatchRow.description: A dispatch-ledger `dispatch` event, field for field the shipped vocabulary and types (lib/dispatch-ledger.js:62-74 allow-list, :150-165 validator): closed like the shipped allow-list (an unknown field drops the event), model/effort_*/transport_derived nullable strings, tokens_*/usd/duration_ms nullable FINITE numbers (not integers, no minimum), usd_source reported|estimated|null. The only intended difference: site is "experiment-stage", which G2 adds to DISPATCH_SITES. Summed into metrics.cost; any null usd makes the sum null.

effort.description: Allowed resolved efforts, from lib/model-catalog.js:11 (the catalog's own list). resolveAgentConfig returns null effort for a tier with no thinking config (for example claude::budget); record that as "unavailable". A tier label such as "standard" is never an effort.

checkpointCase.description: One worked decision of rules.checkpoint. row names the rules.checkpoint.rows id that must decide it; the oracle runs a reference decide() over input and compares expect.
